sourceText: 按照上面的建议，马上开一个story，马上修复，一定要删除 story-review.ts 中递归 readFileSync() 所有 requirements Markdown 的逻辑，以及 truthDocs.join(...)；不然一个简单的story就把额度烧穿。并记录这个任务总共消耗多少token，最大开销在什么地方。
normalizedOutcome: story_review no longer reads or embeds the requirements Markdown corpus; an ordinary story produces a bounded structured PLAN prompt, with pre/post token-cost measurement and dominant-source attribution.
acceptanceClaim: A focused regression proves unrelated multi-megabyte requirements content is absent and does not change _reviewPrompt bytes while structured PLAN sections remain, and reports the measured pre/post cost.
